notes: Tier rates are constant across all meter sizes within a classification; only minimumCharge changes by size.
minimumCharge covers usage from 1 to 10 cu.m flat (no per-cu.m add-on).
Computation is cumulative/additive per tier, not usage x rate. Example: Residential/Government, size 0.5, usage 12 cu.m = 170.00 + (18.25 x 2) = 206.50.
usage = presentReading - previousReading. If presentReading < previousReading, raise a validation error.
waterMeterMaintenanceFee (PHP 20.00) is added on top of minimumCharge + tier charges on every bill, regardless of classification, size, or usage.
Full example: Residential/Government, size 0.5, previousReading 1589, presentReading 1600 (usage 11) = 170.00 + 18.25 + 20.00 = 208.25 total.
If a classification+meterSize combination is not found below, throw a validation error rather than defaulting to a guessed rate.
Flat Rate billing (accounts with no meter reading) is NOT yet in scope. Do not implement unless explicitly instructed.
